verdict.rationale: Florida DOR runs online eServices portals (eFile and Pay, the Business Tax Application), so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of service. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookies, tracking controls or any opt-out mechanism. The items cover reemployment tax filing, E-Verify certification, batch enrollment and login flows, none of which are about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
